OQC Toshiko

Oxford Quantum Circuits

OQC Toshiko

Oxford Quantum Circuits · superconducting circuits · DEPLOYED (2024) · 32 physical qubits · access: cloud service in colocation data centres (UK, Spain, Japan)
architecture: סריג טרנסמונים עם מצמדים ברי-כוונון · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: Coaxmon - patented 3-D out-of-plane coaxial control architecture, no on-chip control wiring
gate mechanism: not published - no native 2Q gate name, gate time or degree anywhere in OQC's material
connectivity: not published
control: control and readout enter perpendicular to the chip plane
control placement: room-temp (out-of-plane)
readout: dispersive
flags: no published error rates, specification absent

Technologies by layer — the machine's cell per layer

1 נושא הקיוביט
טרנסמון · primary ▣ Fig. 1D-F (four-qubit coaxmon circuit in enclosure; transmon + spiral resonator); §II Device architecture ✅
Coaxmon transmon: 3-D out-of-plane coaxial control, no on-chip control wiring; 32 qubits, third generation (after Lucy 8, Sophia 4)
2 קידוד
תת-מרחב דו-רמתי חשוף · primary ◌ 🔎
bare transmon two-level subspace; no encoding beyond the physical qubit
3 מנגנון השער
— undisclosed — exists, nothing published ▣ Fig. 5 (single-qubit RB only); §V Single qubit gate errors ✅
gate mechanism not published: no native 2Q gate name, gate time or connectivity degree; no 1Q/2Q fidelities published
4 קישוריות והובלה
סריג סטטי של שכנים קרובים · primary ▣ Fig. 1D (four qubits in a square lattice, 2 mm spacing); §II ✅
nearest-neighbour lattice assumed; connectivity not published
5 בקרה
הולכת אותות אנכית (מחוץ למישור) — VIO, קואקסמון, חיווט תלת-ממדי · primary ▣ Fig. 2A (cross-section of out-of-plane wiring addressing a qubit); Fig. 1A-B (through-holes for out-of-plane wiring) ✅
Coaxmon out-of-plane I/O: control and readout enter perpendicular to the chip plane; no Atlas technology
אלקטרוניקה בטמפרטורת החדר + קואקס/כבל גמיש לכל קיוביט · alternate ▣ Fig. 4A (qubit control line selectivity); §IV.A 🔎
room-temperature control delivered out-of-plane (Coaxmon)

קריאה דיספרסיבית במיקרוגל (+TWPA, מסנן פרסל) · primary ▤ §III Basic characterization / §IX Materials and Methods (heterodyne single-shot readout, 5 µs pulses) 🔎
dispersive readout, entering out-of-plane; no readout fidelity published
